title: Competition statistics
description: Imported official results by dog and period.
noStandings: No standings have been imported for this season.
noRuns: No results have been imported for this year.
noDogs: You have no active dogs yet.
scoredTrials: {count, plural, one {# trial with points} other {# trials with points}}
officialPointsHelp: P, PV and PA are clear rounds. A run with PA / PV counts once under Clear rounds. Percentages use runs with a known outcome; average speed uses completed runs with a reported speed.
noScoredRuns: No runs with points in this period.
adminDescription: Preview the source and review each result’s dog before publishing it to their statistics.
fcagHelp: Paste a division standings link from app.fcagility.cat. The public page will be read. You can optionally upload saved HTML.
flowHelp: Paste a FlowAgility run results link. It will be read using the club connection, if configured. You can also upload saved HTML from the print view or a reviewed CSV using the template. Preserve P, PA and PV exactly as reported by the source.
fileTooLarge: The content is too large to import. Try the results link instead.
invalidImport: The source or selection could not be validated. Check the link, format and licences. If the preview expired, prepare it again. Previous results are preserved.
matchingHelp: Only unique exact licence matches are suggested. Review the suggestions. Results without a selected dog will not be imported.
noMatches: No matches found. Show all results to assign them manually.
replaceWarning: I have reviewed the selection. This import replaces previous results from the same source and season, including results I have not selected this time.
saved: {count, plural, one {# result imported} other {# results imported}}
noHistory: No results have been imported yet.
sourceAuthRequired: The club’s FlowAgility session needs to be configured or renewed. You can upload saved HTML from the printable results in the meantime.

progress.licenseGrade: Grade registered on the RSCE licence.
progress.observedGrade: Based on the latest imported competition, on {date}.
progress.unknownGrade: No grade is recorded. Complete the RSCE licence in the dog’s profile.
progress.gradeConflict: The licence grade and results disagree. Flow records {grade} on {date}. Check the grade with your club before confirming promotion or qualification.
progress.demotion: Results from a higher grade exist. Your club must verify the date and conditions of the downgrade; promotion progress only counts results after the last competition in the higher grade.
progress.lifetime: Promotion points include all imported history, regardless of the selected year. G2 promotion points do not expire.
progress.noHistory: There are no imported results for this licence yet.
progress.g1Both: G1 → G2 · alternative: 2 Agility and 2 Jumping
progress.g2Promotion: G2 → G3 · 3 Agility PA and 3 Jumping PA
progress.g2Championship: Standard G2 route · 6 points, including at least 4 PV per discipline
progress.g3Championship: Standard G3 route · 4 PV earned in G3 per discipline
progress.afterPromotion: G2 route after promotion to G3 during the year
progress.pointsReached: Point target reached using imported data. Your club must verify the remaining conditions.
progress.judges: At least two different judges are required. This has not yet been verified in the imported results.
progress.promotionNotice: This route requires your club to have notified the RSCE of promotion before competing in G3.
progress.noAutomaticPromotion: Reaching the point target does not change the grade automatically. Promotion is not allowed during the same competition or on the same day.
progress.g1NoChampionship: In G1, the standard route is promotion to G2; its points do not count towards the Spanish Championship. The regulations include exceptions for J12 and Para-Agility.
progress.olderRules: The 2026 regulations are not applied here to earlier periods. You can view the original points for that year.
progress.annual: Points earned from 1 January to 31 December {year}. PV count towards the total points; they are not counted twice.
progress.importedOnly: Progress uses imported results and official source awards, separately for each licence. Results from other sources or before the available history may be missing. A PA / PV label adds one PA and one PV, but only one round.
progress.specialRoutes: These counters show the standard route. Island residency, double points at island competitions, debutants, J12, Para-Agility and direct qualification require specific verification with your club.
progress.source: RSCE regulations effective 1 July 2026 · articles 60–63 and 71

comparison.title: Last three years compared
comparison.description: Compare each year’s imported results. Available dates, competition counts and grades may differ; the current year is still in progress.
comparison.legend: The bars highlight clear rounds within the total number of runs.
comparison.chartValue: {clear} clear / {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
comparison.samplesHelp: Percentages use runs with a known outcome. Unknown data do not count as a clear or an elimination. Average speed excludes eliminations and unreported speeds.
